physical_status_assessment.decision: Qualifies provisionally as a dated issuer physical-construction-status disclosure at broad under_construction level, subject to independent review. The 99% cost figure is not the basis for inferring a physical percentage or a specific installation milestone.
physical_status_assessment.authority: PT Indointernet Tbk consolidated financial statements, prepared and authorized by its board.

source_pages.1: Report identity and June 30 reporting date.
source_pages.11: Printed Schedule 5/3, note 1(d): statements completed and authorized for issuance on July 29, 2026.
source_pages.21: Printed Schedule 5/13, note 2(j): construction and machinery-installation costs remain assets under construction until construction or installation is complete.
source_pages.47: Printed Schedule 5/39, note 8: unfinished EDGE2 phase-3 electrical/mechanical development as at June 30, distinct from completed phase 2 and DGE projects.

physical_status_assessment.reasoning: The note expressly identifies unfinished tangible electrical/mechanical construction at a named phase, not merely an aggregate capital budget, financing plan or future announcement. The accounting policy supports that narrow interpretation. It does not establish inspection, a particular trade's current activity, commissioning or energization.
physical_status_assessment.date_guardrail: June 30 is the stated observation date. July 29 is authorization for issuance, not publication or a later physical observation. The August URL directory and September capture do not establish publication day or refresh status.

historical_cross_check.finding: At December 31, 2025 the same named phase 3 remained unfinished at 65% of estimated completion cost. Phase 2 was completed and operating in 2025; phase 1 was completed in Q2 2024 and operating in Q3 2024.
historical_cross_check.guardrail: 65% to 99% is cost-accounting change, not independently measured physical progress. The older observation is not selected.

locator_assessment.decision: Exact named operator source point recovered; explicit horizontal datum/CRS still unbound, so no admission geometry selected.
locator_assessment.literal_pointer: Page 1 EDGE2 / Jakarta heading, location map and Address line.
locator_assessment.source_crs_unknown_reason: Neither complete specsheet page names a horizontal datum, EPSG code, georeferencing standard or map provider. The PDF has no link annotations. Current local and global facility pages supply no numeric map coordinates or map-service linkage.
locator_assessment.horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: The source states no positional-accuracy estimate or survey method. Four decimal places express numeric precision, not an 11-metre accuracy guarantee.
locator_assessment.meaning: Operator-published facility reference point at the specifically named EDGE2 address. Not an office pin, locality centroid, parcel boundary, building footprint or observed-work location.
locator_assessment.metadata_date_guardrail: Metadata and URL year are not asserted as publication dates. The point is historical identity/location evidence only.
locator_assessment.map_review: The rendered page shows Jakarta streets including Kuningan Mulia and Menteng Atas with the EDGE2 locator. Stray extracted Valenzuela/Quezon text is not visible on the reviewed map and is not used as location evidence. No source map was digitized or redistributed.
locator_assessment.remaining_gate: Bind these geographic coordinates to an explicit operator/regulator CRS or obtain an independently authoritative named-campus point with explicit CRS. Do not silently label this source WGS84.

identity_and_successors.identity_finding: The operator's February 28, 2024 announcement names EDGE2 at Jl. Kuningan Mulia, identifies PT Ekagrata Data Gemilang and Indonet, and places EDGE1 less than 3 km away. Virtual campus describes connectivity, not one contiguous physical site.
identity_and_successors.search_scope: Bounded original-source searches on indonet.id, id.digitaledgedc.com and digitaledgedc.com, with EDGE2 / EDGE 2, phase 3 / fase 3, 2026, completed / selesai and August terms; financial-report index, current facility pages and operator resource index read.
identity_and_successors.finding: No authoritative phase-3 completion or cancellation through August 20 was found. The 2024 campus launch and 2025 phase-2 completion precede, and do not supersede, the explicitly unfinished June 2026 phase-3 statement. Generic current operational descriptions and later page-update labels do not settle phase-3 completion.
identity_and_successors.limitation: Bounded public-source result, not exhaustive proof of absence. The source's expected completion during 2026 is a forecast. The current resource index highlights CGK rather than a phase-3 completion, and is only an absence check over the visible index.
do_not_merge: DGE1 and DGE2 construction projects in the financial note
CGK Campus at GIIC Cikarang, Bekasi
PT Digital Gayana Ekagrata versus PT Ekagrata Data Gemilang

distinctness_review.method: All complete Point/Polygon/MultiPolygon geometries screened with Shapely, including polygon holes, against the literal geographic point; all properties screened for EDGE2 / EDGE 2 / Ekagrata / Kuningan Mulia. Source inventory has no existing EDGE2 record.
distinctness_review.crs_limitation: Geographic-degree comparison and WGS84 geodesic distances are diagnostic assumptions only while the printed point's datum remains unknown. No admission or exact surveyed clearance claim.
distinctness_review.distance_scope: WGS84 geodesic distances to selected geometry representative points, not minimum boundary clearances or selected coordinate derivations.
